customView.title: General Runtime Configuration
customView.description: Configure WiFi and webserver settings for your device
customView.uploadSuccess: WiFi settings saved. Hard reset required to apply.
customView.wifiStaDisabledWarning: The station SSID and password were saved, but "Enable Station (STA)" is off, so the device will not join that network. Tick the checkbox in WiFi Settings and upload again.
customView.wifiApDisabledWarning: The access-point password was saved, but "Enable Access Point (AP)" is off, so the access point will not start. Tick the checkbox in WiFi Settings and upload again.
customView.mqttDisabledWarning: The MQTT settings were saved, but "Enable MQTT" is off, so nothing is published or subscribed and Home Assistant stays empty. Expand the MQTT Settings section, tick "Enable MQTT" and upload again.
